rule: A source family (registry_id) may appear in a customer report only if it is listed under `cleared` with an audit reference. Unlisted means excluded. A HOLD is never cleared (founder ruling R4). Adding an entry is a recorded decision, never a default.

entry_shape.registry_id: the source family exactly as app_projects.registry_id spells it; no wildcard
entry_shape.audit_ref: where the clearance is recorded (file and section)
entry_shape.attribution: the credit line the report must carry, or an empty string if none is required
